newsitem.title: USA: Ultramar cost savings ahead of schedule.
newsitem.headline: Ultramar cost savings ahead of schedule.

text.p: Refining and marketing company Ultramar Diamond Shamrock Corp said Tuesday the cost savings from the newly merged company were ahead of schedule, bringing total benefits from the merger to about $35 million this year.
"Since the combination of Ultramar and Diamond Shamrock last December, the company has benefited from geographical diversity and reliable operations," it said in a statement.
The company said it expected to exceed the $75 million in benefits projected for 1998.

Diamond Shamrock Inc and Ultramar Corp entered a $850-million stock-swap merger at the end of last year. The merger formed the fourth largest independent refining and marketing company in North America.
The company also said it had begun to see improvements in refining margins on the U.S. West Coast.
"All four of our refineries are running well, many at record volumes," it said. "Additionally, retail fuel volumes are at record levels throughout the company."
Ultramar Diamond Shamrock reported a second-quarter profit of $0.58 per diluted share, compared with $0.60 for the same quarter last year.
